title: Unified architecture requirements
summary: Stable requirement IDs used by implementation mappings and acceptance evidence.

requirements.statement: One public route has exactly one Markdown source file.
requirements.verification: route inventory plus duplicate negative fixture

requirements.statement: Configuration files contain composition only and reject unknown keys.
Language packs contain only engine UI messages.
Markdown compiles into typed IR with source provenance.
All document nodes use one renderer registry.
All ui.* and docara.* component nodes use one Smart gateway.
requirements.verification: manifest, params, assets and unknown-component tests

requirements.statement: Full and page builds call the same PageBuilder.
Every declared locale has explicit route and missing-page behavior.
Generated IR, HTML and indexes are disposable.
Engine and Framework inputs are immutable and recorded.
requirements.verification: lock validation and two clean builds

requirements.statement: Legacy paths are deleted only after parity and zero-reference evidence.
No architecture acceptance implies release or production readiness.
